items.title: 游戏结束／复活
items.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer, high-fidelity mobile game UI mockup for art approval only.
Image 1 is the existing game screenshot and is the authoritative layout/content reference. Other supplied images are the already approved game style and must govern rendering. Create ONE full portrait 1080x1920 in-game mockup. Preserve the size and screen position of the principal popup or machine and all original controls from image 1. Preserve the dimmed navy vault home background, existing HUD and screen aspect ratio; omit the debug GM badge and stray foreground confetti for clean review. Change only the foreground interface skin. Use the same polished casual mobile-game aesthetic as the approved reference: saturated royal blue and cyan enamel, rounded glass-like bevels, slim lustrous gold trim, pale icy cyan inner panels, rich navy outlines, soft extruded shadows, glossy lime-green buttons with warm gold rims, crisp white rounded bold lettering. Replace all old cloud decorations with restrained star/gold/crown accents appropriate to these approved references. Clear readable exact English text. No phone frame, editor chrome, outside labels, contact sheet, extra action buttons, price promises or invented features. This is a coherent sibling interface, not a different art direction.
Foreground: Game Over / revive offer. Keep tall modal at approximately x65..1015 y435..1555 of source. Cyan royal-blue header, approved settings-style gold divider, icy body. Top right orange-gold rounded X matching the Settings reference, same original control location. Exact title "Game Over". Center "Score" and large gold-gradient "570". Two neat rows at original locations: "High Score" with "612", "Earned" with "×50". Bottom single wide glossy lime-green/gold button labeled "Revive" with circular white video play icon on left. Only this button and X; no restart button. Keep original informational hierarchy and generous original spacing.
